fields.summary: Add user search to admin console
fields.description:
Admins need to find users by email in the admin console.

Requirements:
1. Only admins can use search. Non-admins get a PermissionError.
2. Match email substring, case-insensitive.
3. Return 20 results per page. Page numbers start at 1.
4. An empty search term is rejected with 'term required'.
5. Never build SQL from user input.

comments.body: Search should also work on partial emails like 'sam@'.
Layout screenshot attached. Ignore the old export button.
